consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-12: Generated-product residency manifest (data_classes/home_region/allowed_regions/backup/kms/egress/retention) + build/deploy gate
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema includes data_classes, home_region, allowed_regions, replication_policy, backup_regions, kms_policy, allowed_subprocessors, model_processing_regions, egress_policy, retention_policy, transfer_approval_ref, evidence_requirements.
Build/deploy gate rejects a missing/invalid manifest.
PF does not route generated-product runtime data through itself by default.
ADR exists and is linked from decisions.md index (or ADR-0003 is created/retired).
develop commit SHA is pinned in the item/epic and quoted in downstream items.
ADR states the interface-first, PG-SoR, object-store, tenant-isolation and residency decisions with L1-L4.
The 11 interfaces are declared with explicit optional capabilities (versioning/lock/conditional-write/KMS/signed-URL/multipart).
A conformance suite runs against any adapter (starting with WorkerGrid's store as reference).
No domain module depends on a concrete provider.
private buckets, least-privilege credentials, lifecycle/versioning where required; explicit region/backup/replication capability metadata.
Signed URLs only after authorization, constrained to object/method, short TTL.
Provider config stays inside the adapter; conformance suite passes (wrong-region, versions, delete, restore).
lifecycle rules + optional object lock/immutability; versioning where required.
delete reconciles DB record, object versions, replicas and backups per retention; tenant deletion includes objects.
orphaned-object and lifecycle-expiry tests pass.

conflict_findings: BI-PF-1308 also touches retention/reconciliation concepts; align field definitions
duplication_findings: core/qa_manifest.py and run_manifest.py already produce manifests; reuse their patterns rather than a new manifest component
file-manifest.json covers file inventory, not residency — extend, not duplicate
to.rationale: Manifest extends existing manifest builders; only the Go gate check is modestly new.
assumptions: Manifest rides with existing packaging build artifact
Region topology known from EDP ADR (BI-PF-1293)
risks: Go gate must satisfy language rule L1 review
Region/KMS field values depend on provider adapters (BI-PF-1306)
missing_info: Enforcement action on gate failure: block vs warn

context_review.reason: Existing manifest modules and packaging APIs provide clear extension points; depends on EDP predecessor items.

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-12: Generated-product residency manifest (data_classes/home_region/allowed_regions/backup/kms/egress/retention) + build/deploy gate
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema includes data_classes, home_region, allowed_regions, replication_policy, backup_regions, kms_policy, allowed_subprocessors, model_processing_regions, egress_policy, retention_policy, transfer_approval_ref, evidence_requirements.
Build/deploy gate rejects a missing/invalid manifest.
PF does not route generated-product runtime data through itself by default.
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
L1 Go rule passes language_rule_review.py
11 Go interfaces defined in internal/storage/ with godoc and compile-time assertions
Conformance harness package exposes embeddable test suites per interface
In-memory reference adapter passes all conformance suites
scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py passes (Go-only)
config/test-matrix.json extended with storage-conformance rows
Adapter passes the shared conformance suite against MinIO in CI
Capabilities (region/replication/versioning) exposed via capability probe API
Language rule L1 (Go) passes scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py
No credentials logged; env-based config only
lifecycle rules + optional object lock/immutability; versioning where required.
delete reconciles DB record, object versions, replicas and backups per retention; tenant deletion includes objects.
orphaned-object and lifecycle-expiry tests pass.
